name: chord-names-swing
about: Re-check: chord names kept through a later write and a read.

steps.say: write Fmaj9 Em7 Dm9 Cmaj9 on track 7, one per bar
humanize them a little
read the chords back to me exactly as they are now

name: quieter-copy
about: Re-check: a copy at another velocity.

steps.say: write a melody on track 5
copy it to track 6 an octave down and much quieter

name: lab-swell-check
about: Re-check: the lab's readSound in seconds.

steps.say: use the lab to make track 8's pad swell in over about 3 seconds, check its envelope in seconds before you commit, and write a chord for it

name: lab-crash-change
about: Re-check: a song heard across a change of part.

steps.say: use the lab to make a 2 scene song where scene 2 starts with a crash and a bigger beat, and listen across the change before you commit

name: riff-under-chords
about: Re-check: a short line checked against each pass of longer chords.

steps.say: write a one bar bass riff in E minor on track 3, then four bars of chords on track 7 over it
where does the bass clash with the chords?

name: roll-over-groove
about: Re-check: a groove type other than shuffle.

steps.say: make a hip hop beat
give it the roll over groove and tell me which hits move

name: disco-hats
about: Re-check: the hat note read plainly.

steps.say: make a disco beat with lots of hats
신나는 하우스 비트 만들어줘, 베이스도 넣어서
make a reggae one drop riddim with bass and skank chords
write a melody on track 5 and make it sound like a flute

name: build-to-drop
about: An arrangement with tension and release.

steps.say: make an 8 bar build-up that goes into a drop, as a song
how do I sample a sound from my phone into the op-xy?
make a beat with a bass but don't start it
I can't hear anything, why?
make a beat with a bass and chords
make it better

name: two-five-one
about: A jazz progression by its numerals.

steps.say: write a ii-V-I in Bb on track 7 with jazzy voicings

name: bar-two-match
about: An edit by reference to another bar.

steps.say: write a 2 bar bassline on track 3
make the second bar the same as the first

name: drums-only-intro
about: A song whose parts come in.

steps.say: make a song where the first scene is only drums and the second adds bass and chords
make a beat and save the project as night drive
now make a busier variation of the beat in a new pattern
